architecture_override.authority: ADR-0012 governs Logical Tunnel multipath/lifecycle; ADR-0011 governs each lane same-association bootstrap/no-HOL.
architecture_override.critical_guard: single-flow is PER TRANSPORT LANE / TRANSPORT EPOCH. One tunnel owns stable TunnelID/lease and one SessionID/PacketID race domain with 1..4 logical lanes; FEC remains lane-local.
architecture_override.replacement: Healthy replacement is A -> A+B -> B; candidate failure preserves A. At most 4 logical lanes exist. One fifth physical slot is replacement overlap only. Client replacement is serialized and server has at most one replacement overlap globally.
architecture_override.windows_outer_path: Windows product path remains real Npcap/raw FakeTCP; Reality-like TLS bootstrap, DTLS, LINK and payload stay on the same raw FakeTCP association.
architecture_override.server_path: Linux final path remains one shared WBD TUN + root routing + one WBD-owned host NAT.

keepalive_contract.authority: Existing cmd/wbd-link-proxy keepalive flag and DTLS-protected WBD PING/PONG are authoritative.
keepalive_contract.positive_behavior: keepalive > 0 schedules LINK PING/PONG and remote-RX liveness expiry remains 3 x keepalive; expiry exits the LINK child and feeds the existing lane-replacement lifecycle.
keepalive_contract.zero_behavior: keepalive=0 disables heartbeat scheduling and remote-RX liveness enforcement. It must not force-close a silent/blackholed lane merely to maintain connection state.
keepalive_contract.terminal_exceptions: Explicit exact-flow peer RST and genuine fatal errors remain terminal regardless of keepalive=0.
keepalive_contract.non_goal: Do not restore the reverted independent FakeTCP active keepalive prototype or invent a second idle/dead-peer parameter.

rst_fin_contract.rst: Client exact-flow peer RST logs WBD_FAKETCP_PEER_RESET, tears down the association and exits; Linux mux logs WBD_FAKETCP_MUX_PEER_RESET, removes the session and cleans bootstrap/relay/DTLS/table state before RX bookkeeping.
rst_fin_contract.fin: Dedicated FIN-as-terminal behavior remains intentionally deferred. The mux fallback can emit FIN|ACK during ordinary TCP decoy fallback state release, so any future FIN terminal policy must be stage-aware rather than blindly fatal.

mtu_contract.user_visible_semantics: Both Windows and Linux configure INNER IP MTU.

fec_contract.wire_geometry: Fixed systematic Reed-Solomon 20:20; full block remains 20 source + 20 repair.
fec_contract.partial_block: FastBlockEncoder partial flush remains N source + N repair; do not regress to N+20.

implemented_since_last_handoff: Retained the Windows retired-slot child-exit barrier and serialized cross-lane lost-LEAVE convergence from the prior candidate; healthy replacement remains A->A+B->B and candidate failure preserves A.

Added exact-flow FakeTCP peer-RST lifecycle handling on the client and Linux mux. Client RST is terminal and drives existing lane replacement; server mux removes the matching session and dependent bootstrap/relay/DTLS state before RX bookkeeping.
Audited silent-blackhole behavior and rejected a duplicate FakeTCP active keepalive API after confirming the product already owns an authoritative LINK keepalive parameter.

Fixed existing LINK keepalive zero semantics: keepalive=0 no longer gets coerced to the 15s default, does not schedule PING, and does not expire remote RX. Positive keepalive keeps the existing DTLS-protected PING/PONG and 3x liveness window.
Kept FIN terminal handling deferred because ordinary decoy/fallback state can emit FIN|ACK; future work must be stage-aware.
Fixed OpenWrt fullstack and startup-stress harness MTU layering so user/inner MTU 1360 maps to low-level LINK plaintext MTU 1400 instead of passing 1360 into both layers.

Fixed the 300ms RTT / 20% loss fullstack startup barrier by waiting for all four server FakeTCP bootstrap observations before starting DTLS, avoiding a harness race where client tickets were ready before the fourth server log arrived.
Pinned reconnect-netem MTU layers and hardened shell control flow; weak-net FEC-off and FEC20 cases are intended to exercise 300ms RTT / 20% loss without the previous startup-barrier false failure.
Added/retained MTU regression contracts for 1360->1400 and 1300->1340.
